values.note: City of Winterset: RV sites 1-40 $25 a night; tent sites $15; $5 reservation fee. Stays of 7 nights or more $20 a night, booked by phone and paid in full up front; groups of 6+ sites $22 a site. Firewood $5 a bundle. Read 2026-11-03.

values.note: Level gravel back-in RV sites; sewer at 28 of the 40 (not 1-3, 18-24, 39, 40); water shared between pairs of sites. Plus 5 tent sites.

values.note: Online on Bookmysites from January 1 (up to 6 consecutive nights, at least 2 days ahead); otherwise by phone, Parks & Recreation 515-462-3258, Mon-Fri 8-4:30, same-day if sites are free. A Friday or Saturday booking must take both nights; holidays 3 nights; Covered Bridge Festival weekend (2nd weekend of October) 4 nights. Stays of 7+ nights and groups by phone; max 30 days (sometimes extended). Unreserved sites first come, first served.

booking.source: https://winterset.gov/247/City-Park-Campground ('Online Reservations (Open January 1st)', 'Minimum 2 days in advance, otherwise must call the office during business hours', 'If reserving a Friday or Saturday, you must reserve both days', 'The holiday will require a 3-night minimum reservation', 'Covered Bridge Festival weekend (2nd weekend in October) requires a minimum of 4 nights', 'First come first serve may be available unless reserved', 'Reservations over the phone can be made on the day of a visit if sites are available', 'Maximum stay is 30 days') + policies PDF ('Online reservations can only be made for 6 consecutive nights'), read 2026-11-03

note: City of Winterset Parks & Recreation campground beside historic Winterset City Park, with a camp host on site; water is shared between pairs of sites and tents are limited to two per site. --Claude
summary: $25 and $5 reservation fee confirmed (7+ nights $20); 15/30/50 amp, water, sewer confirmed (no sewer at 12 sites); 40 sites, max rig 50 cleared (no length posted); showers/dump; season Apr 1 - Nov 15 confirmed; booking phone -> online Bookmysites + phone, weekend 2 / holiday 3 / festival 4-night minimums, 30-night max.
